scope_notes: Thrown/hand grenades are excluded as usable weapon profiles because GGA handles grenade mechanics separately.
Grenade launchers remain in the catalog as ranged weapons.
Warhead/effect labels embedded in excluded grenade templates are retained only as reference-only payload metadata for future Ultra-Tech payload switching.
Governing Skill is auto-resolved only when the GCS mode contains exactly one unmodified, non-wildcard skill default. Ambiguous or default-only cases are flagged for manual review.
Firearm action is not guessed from external knowledge in this pass; only literal action hints present in the equipment library text are stored.
v2 adds rules-assisted weapon mechanism/fire-mode metadata, technique capability metadata, structured attack resolution, payload-carrier metadata, and governing-skill selection strategy.
Rules-assisted enrichment uses GURPS Basic Set, High-Tech, Ultra-Tech, and Tactical Shooting where available. Uncertain mechanisms are left unknown rather than guessed.
Grenades remain excluded as active weapon profiles; reference payload templates are retained only for future launcher/warhead support.
v3 records the manual rules audit of Fast-Firing, Fanning, Thumbing, and Two-Handed Thumbing.
Fast-Firing now uses a strict-positive policy: if the rules/source do not explicitly establish a compatible mechanism, eligibility is false rather than unknown.
Fanning/Thumbing eligibility is restricted to source-confirmed single-action revolver modes using Guns (Pistol); special secondary barrels do not inherit revolver eligibility.
v4 completes the manual Governing Skill audit of all entries that were `ambiguous` or `fallback-only` in v3.
The concrete GGA attack Level remains the base value for actual attack rolls. Catalog skill/default relations are metadata and MUST NOT be applied again as combat modifiers.
Manual Governing Skill override by the user has priority over catalog automation.
For best-available resolutions, choose the best actually available Actor skill after the listed relation modifiers; on ties retain the existing binding, otherwise use stable catalog order.

enrichment_sources.usage: trigger mechanisms, firearm action types, automatic/controlled burst semantics
UT weapon families, cone/affliction behavior, gyroc/missile/warhead semantics
Fast-Firing, Fanning, Thumbing, Two-Handed Thumbing compatibility rules

source_data_corrections.basis: Ultra-Tech Zap Glove text/table: Boxing, Brawling, or Karate

rules_audit_v3.known_exception: Girard LeMat Shot Barrel explicitly excluded

governing_skill_contract.description: For an imported GGA/GCS weapon attack, the concrete attack Level is the actual base for the roll. Catalog default/relation modifiers describe how the attack relates to a parent skill and are not combat modifiers.
best_available_tie_break: retain existing manual/saved binding if tied
otherwise use stable catalog candidate order
governing_skill_contract.wildcard_skills: Wildcard skills may be retained as alternative source candidates where the source/library provides them, but they must not replace the canonical governing skill used to identify techniques unless explicitly selected by the user.

source_corrections: Cutlass (Swung): canonical Governing Skill corrected to Shortsword.
Elgin Cutlass Pistol (Swung/Thrust): canonical Governing Skill corrected to Knife with -1 relation; Sword! retained only as wildcard alternative.
Crowbar, Large (Thrust): missing primary Two-Handed Axe/Mace relation restored.
Large/Small Throwing Knife (Swung/Thrust): corrected to Knife-2 relation.
Throwing Axe (Thrown): corrected to Thrown Weapon (Axe/Mace) with no extra relation penalty.

ammunition_catalog_link.link_scope: Ultra-Tech TL9+ projectile weapon modes only
ammunition_catalog_link.manual_ammo_override_policy: A future UI may allow a GM/player override, but automatic matching must use these stable links, never caliber-only matching.
ammunition_catalog_link.notes_policy: Concrete load Notes are stored on the ammunition load/magazine instance, not on the global warhead definition.

rules_audit_v5.policy: Only source-confirmed Ultra-Tech TL9+ weapon/ammunition relationships are linked. Numeric caliber matching across books is forbidden.

rules_audit_v5_1.scope: Optional, user-authorized ammunition TL compatibility exception for Sniper Railgun, 7mm; no weapon stats or Governing Skill changed.
rules_audit_v5_1.source_status: OleGURPS optional interpretation of unresolved published TL mismatch, not official errata.

rules_audit_v5_2.scope: UT weapon modes with non-damage attacks, HT/Will Afflictions, cone/jet or linked/special attacks
rules_audit_v5_2.post_roll_hints: chat_effect_hint per relevant primary weapon mode; linked secondary GCS mode attaches to parent and is not a new independent attack
rules_audit_v5_2.render_policy: Collapsible text below GGA-native attack roll; no own HT/Will/check rolls and no automatic conditions/damage.
rules_audit_v5_2.source_book: GURPS Ultra-Tech, pp. 113-124, 165 and relevant weapon table references
rules_audit_v5_2.warning: Some devices with undefined/variable setting retain an explicit GM decision, not invented damage or effects.

lt_ammunition_catalog_link.link_scope: Low-Tech weapon modes only; never generalize by shared diameter or projectile label

rules_audit_v5_3.scope: LT ammunition reference, source-specific mode links; original modes and all UT links unchanged

rules_audit_v5_4.change: Added source-gated exact High-Tech mode ammo links only; GGA stats unchanged.

rules_audit_v5_5.notes: Rocket calibers are tube vs warhead, guided speed vs minimum range, separate launchers, no new GGA roll

catalog_errata_v1.source: GURPS High-Tech pp.120, 145; source corrections supplied and verified by the user

rules_audit_v5_6.scope: UT Paint Gun platform tags only; HT178 structured source-rule metadata resides in HT catalog v1.2.
